Flappy Voice — Gemini asset prompt pack

Use Gemini (AI Studio or the Gemini app), model "Nano Banana" / image mode. Attach refs 01–04 to every request and generate one asset per prompt. Each Copy button copies the full text: preamble + palette + that asset. Exact pixel size does not matter — Gemini won't hit it and ffmpeg resizes afterwards; just keep the subject centred and full-frame. Progress is remembered in this browser. Tiles marked tile must loop seamlessly.

Reference images — attach all four to every request. Copy image puts one on the clipboard as PNG; paste it into Gemini, then come back for the next one (the clipboard holds one image at a time). Click a thumbnail to open it full size, or drag it straight into the prompt box. Originals live in Docs/art-refs/.
